detail.longDescription: # ai # stereotype I gave the same prompt to both ChatGPT and Gemini: “a young girl looking at a 19th-century heroine.” (In French) Yes, that’s a vague prompt, but it’s interesting to note the differences between the two results: - # ChatGPT depicts a young woman from the present day observing a painting of a somewhat mythological heroine (Joan of Arc?). - # Gemini depicts an impoverished young girl looking at a suffragette, with the scene set in the 19th century.
